title: Create reusable cook mode ingredient list component
description: Introduce a focused ingredient-list view for cook mode that can render scaled ingredient rows in checklist mode for the gather phase and read-only mode for per-step ingredient display.
acceptance_criteria: A reusable cook-mode ingredient list view exists under `CookbookApp/Recipes`.
The component supports a checklist presentation suitable for the gather phase.
The component also supports a read-only presentation suitable for per-step ingredient summaries.

handoff_summary.completed: Implemented CookModeIngredientList with CookModeIngredientListMode enum (.checklist / .readOnly). Checklist mode renders toggle buttons with strikethrough for checked items, matching IngredientsView's gather pattern. Read-only mode renders a compact non-interactive list. Both modes apply RecipeScale quantity formatting. File registered in the Xcode project via xcodegen; build verified clean.
handoff_summary.remaining: No remaining work in this bead. Downstream beads consuming this component (e.g., cook mode gather phase or step-detail views) will import it from the same Recipes module.
handoff_summary.risks: None identified. The component is additive and doesn't modify any existing files.
handoff_summary.next_action: Pass to tester agent to verify acceptance criteria via UI preview or build validation.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: No file overlap with other in-flight beads. CookModeIngredientList.swift is a new file.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Mode is a plain enum (no associated values) making equality comparison straightforward in ViewBuilder switch. Checked state is internal @State so callers don't manage it; this matches IngredientsView's pattern. Row padding follows the existing IngredientsView/CookwareView visual rhythm (8pt vertical for checklist, 4pt for compact read-only). Dividers omitted intentionally — the component is designed to be embedded in List rows or custom containers where the parent controls separators.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: Three #Preview macros cover checklist mode, read-only mode, and empty state. Unit tests not in scope for this bead.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: Checked state resets when the view is recreated (e.g., navigation pop/push). If persistence of gather state across phase transitions is needed, a future bead should lift @State into a ViewModel or pass a binding.

conflict_risks: No file overlap with other in-flight beads. CookModeIngredientList.swift is a new file.

execution_history.summary: Created CookModeIngredientList.swift — a reusable SwiftUI component supporting both checklist (gather phase) and read-only (per-step) presentation modes for cook mode ingredient display.
